title: The lab dashboard froze for 21 hours: why, and what watches it now
description: AI Foundry lab, 8 October 2026: aifoundry2, the only machine that publishes the lab dashboard, was off for 20 hours after the power cut, and when it came back its visibility check could not find the page among the 50 newest spaces, so it skipped every publish. The check no longer blocks a publish; a keeper on the publishing machines repairs the collector, aifoundry3 stands by to take over, and a watchdog outside the lab alerts the maintainer.
